About Me

The person behind
the strategy

Hi, I'm Shivani Pillai — a marketing enthusiast based in Mumbai with a genuine passion for the art and science of building brands. I believe great marketing is equal parts creativity and strategy, and I'm constantly working to master both.

My interest in marketing grew from a deep curiosity about why people make the decisions they do — why they follow certain brands, trust certain voices, and buy into certain stories. This curiosity led me to explore social media marketing, SEO, content creation, PR, and growth strategies, and I've loved every bit of the learning curve.

I thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments where ideas are valued and execution is everything. Whether it's crafting a compelling social caption, designing a brand post, or thinking through a brand's positioning — I bring energy, attention to detail, and a hunger to do meaningful work.

I'm actively looking for internships and entry-level opportunities where I can contribute to growing brands while continuing to grow myself. If you're building something exciting, I'd love to be part of the team.
